logout.title: Sign out?
logout.description: You will need to sign in again to use the app.
logout.pending: {count, plural, one {# attendance record is} other {# attendance records are}} saved on this device and not sent yet. Connect to the internet and let {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} sync before you sign out.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.description: {name} will not be able to sign in until you activate the account again. Nothing is deleted.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this request?
withdraw.description: The admin will no longer see it. You can send a new request later.

discardAttendance.title: Discard unsaved attendance?
discardAttendance.description: Some marks are not saved yet. If you continue, they will be lost.

bulkMarks.title: Replace the marks?
bulkMarks.description: {count, plural, one {# student already has a different mark and it} other {# students already have a different mark and they}} will be changed to "{status}". Nothing is saved until you press Save.

clearMarks.title: Clear all marks?
clearMarks.description: All {count} marks on this sheet will be removed. Attendance that is already saved stays as it is until you save again.

closeRegistration.title: Close student registration?
closeRegistration.description: Ustazes will not be able to add new students until you open registration again.

platformLists.title: Save the lists for all medresehs?
platformLists.description: Every medreseh that uses the platform lists will see these choices in its forms right away.

usePlatformLists.title: Use the platform lists for {name}?
usePlatformLists.description: The lists {name} edited are kept aside and the platform lists are used instead. You can allow its own lists again later.

removeLogo.title: Remove the logo?
removeLogo.description: The default logo is used on the sign-in page and as the app icon until you upload a new one.

discardForm.title: Discard this form?
discardForm.description: What you typed has not been saved and will be lost.

saveAttendance.title: Save attendance?
saveAttendance.description: Attendance for {className} on {date} will be recorded for {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}. You can still correct it later.
saveAttendance.pastDay: This is not today's attendance: you are saving for {date}.
saveAttendance.unmarked: {count, plural, one {# student has no mark and will not be recorded.} other {# students have no mark and will not be recorded.}}
saveAttendance.smsNext: Next you will be asked to text the parents of the absent students.
